businessMeaning: Prepare one payroll run idempotently by validating and freezing typed source revisions before any calculation and emit the canonical prepared event.

provenExisting: BASE-TFR-PAY-011 already owns run attempts, deterministic calculation, query, approval, finalization, receipts, workers, outbox and V50/V51 schema.
The current calculation seam already performs a prepare-like semantic bind and input freeze before advancing through READY, so PAY-013 overlaps its boundary but is not yet an independent command.
Existing payroll run and input snapshot tables, command receipts and outbox are reusable foundations.
missingWork: Add exact PEP-PAY-011 POST /api/payroll/v1/runs as the idempotent prepare boundary.
Freeze a complete deterministic set of typed source revisions and preflight facts before READY.
Move only the initial freeze responsibility out of PAY-011 calculation so calculation consumes an already frozen READY run.
Emit PayrollRunPrepared.v1 transactionally after the immutable preparation snapshot is complete.
Implement IAQ-014 and the payroll population/preflight workspace.

stateBoundary.retry: PAY-011 retains calculation FAILED retry semantics; prepare replay must not create a new calculation attempt.
stateBoundary.decision: The implementation token must preserve this split and may not leave calculation responsible for the initial source freeze.

reuseOnly: existing command receipt and outbox infrastructure
noTouchOrRecount: Do not create a second payroll calculation engine, run aggregate, receipt store or outbox.
Do not count BASE-TFR-PAY-011 calculation, approval or finalization as PAY-013 delivery.
Do not add DEP-007 or DEP-009 to this slice merely because later payroll calculation may consume those producers.
Do not reopen PAY Foundation settings or BASE-TFR-PAY-007 from the R7-C1 authority-only successor.

readOnlyReusePaths: backend:dwp-payroll-server/src/main/java/com/dwp/services/payroll/calculation/** except the three exact boundary files above

experienceContract.primaryUser: Payroll support viewer preparing a governed payroll population
experienceContract.operationalQuestion: Is the selected payroll population complete, current and safe to freeze for this run?
experienceContract.primaryAction: Review preflight findings and prepare one payroll run from the immutable population snapshot.
experienceContract.relatedRouteRule: Link to the existing payroll command center after preparation; do not rebuild calculation controls on this page.

domainRules: Preparation binds tenant, legal entity, pay group, population, policy revision, semantic mapping revision and every typed source revision.
The frozen snapshot is immutable and calculation may consume it only from READY.
Same idempotency key and canonical body returns the recorded result; a different body conflicts.
A preflight or persistence failure emits neither READY nor PayrollRunPrepared.v1.

migration.reason: The exact preparation source-lineage and preflight facts must be append-only and not overloaded into the attempt-bound PAY-011 snapshot model.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: IAQ-014 returns a deterministic scoped population, revision and preflight summary with stable ordering and bound cursor.
Prepare rejects incomplete, stale, mixed-tenant, mismatched-purpose or unauthorized source revisions before creating READY.
The immutable snapshot contains every typed source identity, revision, digest and preflight decision needed by calculation.
Same idempotency key and canonical request replays the recorded outcome; body mismatch returns conflict without side effects.
Exactly one PayrollRunPrepared.v1 event is observable after commit and no event is emitted on failed preparation.
PAY-011 calculation starts only from READY and consumes the exact frozen snapshot without rebinding or refreezing initial inputs.
Calculation FAILED retry behavior remains owned by PAY-011 and does not create a second prepared snapshot.
Step-up, approval and SoD decisions are enforced from server-verified context; client claims cannot satisfy them.
Loading, empty, unavailable, partial, complete, permission and stale states preserve user inputs and never enable prepare ambiguously.
1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom plus light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion and keyboard navigation pass.
Feature OFF or unenrolled tenant mounts no prepare runtime and issues no population query or command.
Changed-path evidence proves PAY-011 engine, receipts, outbox, R7-C1 settings and historical registers were reused without duplicate completion credit.

backendTargets: existing calculation service and worker tests only where the READY boundary changes
frontendTargets: one population-to-prepare responsive and accessibility journey after central Auth integration
databaseTargets: V52 clean install and V51-to-V52 real PostgreSQL upgrade

required: backend and frontend module branch SHAs
